scope: One preregistered Linux Node/Wasm cohort comparing two fixed artifacts. Original C frontend versus exact-object smaller-stack relink, same shared source-cost worker, SDK, C emitter and six frozen applications. No language semantics, library behavior, production builder, default or adoption change.

protocol.sequence: Application order rotates each round; arm order alternates by round plus unit ID. All raw children preserved; only declared warmups excluded from medians.

load.gate: one-minute value (index zero); parent triples and worker before/after values retained
load.otherLocalCompute: Other local compiler/control owners acknowledged pause before collection; released after completion.

provenance.onlySubjectChange: Exact retained object and dependencies; link stack-size=16777216 → stack-size=131072. Both modules retain the same 109-function proof and 127888-byte conservative bound.

observations.conclusion: Observed latency and physical RSS deltas are mixed; the smaller logical reservation does not establish a general performance or physical-memory benefit. These samples do not justify adoption or a no-regression claim.

metricDefinitions.times: Milliseconds. frontend includes instantiation/upload/parser/checker/typed-IR decoding; pipeline additionally includes the common C emitter. wall includes fresh-process startup, preparation, proof checks, report encoding, close and exit.
metricDefinitions.cpu: CPU milliseconds are user plus system microseconds divided by 1000. Process CPU is sampled during report construction, excluding report encoding/stdout/close/exit; pipeline and frontend CPU cover their named phases.
metricDefinitions.rss: Bytes of live/peak process RSS, not isolated Wasm allocation. Initial RSS/peak and JS heap/external/arrayBuffer counters retained in full analysis.
metricDefinitions.logical: Retained Wasm linear buffer capacity only; lazy pages prevent interpreting this as RSS.
metricDefinitions.deltas: Candidate minus baseline. Percentage is the ratio of per-arm medians minus 1, times 100. All eleven paired differences/percentages and min/max are retained; no significance or cross-platform causal claim.

replay.method: Separate Python implementation reconstructs the exact 144-cell order, validates raw stdout/stderr and subject/output/input/proof/source identities, and recomputes all 168 metric summaries and every paired difference. No sample selection.

validation.note: Build, lint, typecheck and shared controls ran at 72f28071; final 3b60ea37 changes one replay-only association line, then the complete actual cohort and independent replay passed. No compiler or worker source differs between these commits.
validation.fullRepositoryAndPlatformGate: not run for this private measurement increment

limitations: One host and one cohort, descriptive medians only; no significance or universal speed/memory claim.
The one-minute load average began below the registered cutoff and decayed during the coordinated window; deterministic interleaving mitigates but does not eliminate noise/order effects.
Process RSS includes Node/SDK/JIT/GC and preload floors; Wasm capacity changes cannot establish resident-memory savings.
Shipping CLI, graph filesystem I/O, formatter/diagnostic use, model inference and generated-target execution are outside this timed pipeline; prior separate correctness controls remain referenced.
Default 16MiB builders and releases remain unchanged; existing cost losses and pending broader/platform gates remain binding.

archive.normalization: None. All source, records, inputs, logs and raw child stdout/stderr are byte-preserved. members.json binds each raw/stored digest.
